headline: Dark Element Matchups
title: Aniimo Dark Element Explained | What Dark Beats and Fears | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Dark attacks hit Grass, Lightning and Light for super effective damage, which is one more target than most elements. Light and Wind hit Dark hard in return. Dark also deals reduced damage to Water and Wind. Super effective hits do one point six times damage, so pick your Dark target wisely. Bring Dark against Light teams and keep Water or Wind away. Do you run Dark? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Dark element matchups: Dark is strong against Grass, Lightning and Light, takes extra damage from Light and Wind, and is resisted by Water and Wind.
